h1: La Kana Boutique Villa — A Quiet Boutique Villa with a Garden Pool in Central Kamphaeng Phet
intro: If you want a Kamphaeng Phet stay that's quiet and private with a pool to relax in, the name couples and peace-seekers keep coming back to is La Kana Boutique Villa · A small boutique villa set in a garden in the Nakhon Chum area, it's an adults-only stay with modern, well-designed rooms, soft beds, an outdoor pool and a hot tub, plus free parking and free Wi-Fi · It scores around 8.9 from 70 real reviews on Booking.com. Reviews most often mention cleanliness, lovely design and the quiet; the trade-offs are that it's a small property, the pool is more for soaking than swimming, and breakfast is charged extra. body.html: La Kana Boutique Villa is a small boutique villa set in a garden in the Nakhon Chum area, on the west bank of the Ping River in Mueang Kamphaeng Phet district · It's an adults-only stay that positions itself as a quiet retreat rather than a standard town hotel · There are only a handful of rooms, nicely decorated and set at the entrance of a gated community, with a small garden pool as the highlight · Most guests are couples, travellers wanting quiet privacy, and people driving between Bangkok and Chiang Mai who want a comfortable, clean overnight stop.

Rooms range from Standard Double and Standard Twin up to a One-Bedroom Villa with a pool view · The most common praise is that rooms are very clean, beautifully and modernly designed, with soft beds, soft pillows and a fresh, well-kept feel · Many reviews describe it as like staying in a small holiday home that's quiet and private · The trade-off to know going in is that it's a small property — few rooms, some showers are fairly small, and a few reviews mention minor issues like a loose floor tile or slow shower drainage · Overall it stands out for atmosphere and cleanliness rather than the full facilities of a big hotel.

"Room was so clean, beautifully designed, soft bed and pillows, lovely and quiet — had breakfast right by the pool. Staff were sweet. If you're driving from Bangkok to Chiang Mai, this is a perfect overnight stop."

The selling point here is the garden pool and the hot tub · There's an outdoor swimming pool, a hot tub, a sun terrace, a green garden, a small restaurant with room service, free parking, free Wi-Fi and a 24-hour front desk · The garden setting makes it feel relaxed and private · The limits reviews mention are that the pool is fairly small — more for soaking or lounging than serious swimming — and the Wi-Fi signal is weak in spots · Breakfast comes in American and Asian styles, but in some periods it's charged separately from the room and the menu is fairly limited, so check before booking whether it's included.

The location is in the Nakhon Chum area on the west bank of the Ping River · It's about 2 km from the centre of Kamphaeng Phet, roughly a 10-minute drive across the bridge to the Kamphaeng Phet Historical Park, with a convenience store and café nearby · The thing to factor in is that it's not in the heart of the restaurant district — several reviews note it's a bit far from town, so a car makes life easier · It suits self-drivers or anyone using it as an overnight stop · The blended score sits around 8.9 from about 70 real reviews on Booking.com, putting it among the better-rated stays in the province.

To be honest, La Kana is a small boutique villa built around atmosphere, not a big hotel with full facilities · The pool is more for soaking than swimming, there are few rooms, breakfast is charged extra in some periods, Wi-Fi is weak in spots, and the location is a little out from town · If you expect a downtown hotel with a big pool, a gym and full service, it may not be the one · But seen as a quiet, private corner with clean, well-designed rooms and a garden pool to soak in, for couples or anyone wanting to unwind — it does its job well and is good value.

Tips from following the reviews here: for the fullest experience, ask for the One-Bedroom Villa with a pool view for the best space and outlook · Check at booking whether breakfast is included or charged extra, so there's no surprise at checkout · It's an adults-only stay, best for couples or groups of adult friends, not for young children · A car makes the most sense here as it's away from the restaurant district · And always compare the live price on Agoda and Trip.com before booking, since rates move with the season and promotions.

honestSummary: La Kana Boutique Villa nails it for travellers who want a quiet, private corner with clean, well-designed rooms and a garden pool to soak in, for couples or anyone wanting to unwind · Cleanliness, design and the quiet are genuine strengths, backed by an 8.9 score from 70 reviews — but you have to accept it's a small property: the pool is more for soaking than swimming, breakfast is charged extra in some periods, Wi-Fi is weak in spots, and the Nakhon Chum location is a little out from town.
honestChecks: If you want a downtown hotel within walking distance of restaurants — this is in the Nakhon Chum area, about 2 km from the town centre → bring a car or budget for rides.

If you plan to swim seriously or bring young children — the pool is fairly small and more for soaking, and it's an adults-only stay → it suits couples and people wanting to relax more than families with kids.

If you want breakfast and full facilities included — breakfast is charged extra in some periods with a limited menu, and there's no gym → check the package when booking, or pick a larger town hotel if you need more.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — La Kana Boutique Villa, Kamphaeng Phet

faq.q: Where is La Kana Boutique Villa and what's nearby?
faq.a: It's at 111/11 M.2 Nakhon Chum, Mueang Kamphaeng Phet district · On the west bank of the Ping River, about 2 km from the town centre, roughly a 10-minute drive across the bridge to the Kamphaeng Phet Historical Park, and close to Nakhon Chum Market and Wat Phra Borommathat · The thing to factor in is that it's in the Nakhon Chum area, a little out from the main restaurant district, so a car is handier · It's a good overnight stop between Bangkok and Chiang Mai.

faq.q: How much does La Kana Boutique Villa cost and what rooms are available?
faq.a: Rates start from approx. ฿1,500/night for a Standard Double · There's a Standard Twin around ฿1,600, and a One-Bedroom Villa with a pool view around ฿2,200 that's larger and more private · Prices move with the season and promotions, so always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Who is La Kana Boutique Villa best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for couples, travellers wanting quiet privacy, and anyone driving between Bangkok and Chiang Mai who want a clean, well-designed room with a garden pool to soak in · It's an adults-only stay focused on a quiet atmosphere, not suited to young children, and it works best for self-drivers since it's away from town.

faq.q: What are the rooms and cleanliness like at La Kana?
faq.a: Very clean, beautifully and modernly designed rooms with soft beds and pillows, looking fresh and well kept are the common praise, with many reviews describing it as like a small, quiet holiday home · The trade-off is that it's a small property — few rooms, some showers are fairly small, and a few reviews mention minor issues like a loose floor tile or slow drainage.

faq.q: Does La Kana have a pool and breakfast?
faq.a: There's an outdoor garden pool and a hot tub, though many reviews note the pool is fairly small and more for soaking or lounging than serious swimming · Breakfast comes in American and Asian styles, but in some periods it's charged separately from the room and the menu is fairly limited, so check at booking whether it's included · Wi-Fi is free, though the signal is weak in spots.

faq.q: Are the review scores for La Kana reliable?
faq.a: La Kana Boutique Villa has a blended score around 8.9 from about 70 real reviews on Booking.com, putting it among the better-rated stays in Kamphaeng Phet · Its strengths are cleanliness, design and the quiet, making it a strong pick for a private retreat for couples or peace-seekers rather than a fully-equipped town hotel.
